## IT Security Standard

Halvorsen Industrial Systems - All staff - owner: Pirjo Helin

## 1. Identity

Multi-factor authentication is required for all accounts. Privileged accounts use hardware security keys.

Access rights are reviewed every 6 months by department heads.

## 2. Devices

Laptops use full-disk encryption and automatic screen lock after 5 minutes. USB mass storage is blocked by default.

## 3. Incident response

Security incidents are reported to the Security Operations Centre within 2 hours via the IT service desk or [PHONE].
